title: BOC employee faces raps over unfiled SALN

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Finance has pressed charges against a Bureau of Customs (BOC) employee for failing to file his Sworn Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) with the Civil Service Commission National Capital Region (CSC NCR). In a statement on Tuesday, the DOF said its Revenue Integrity Protection Service (RIPS) acted on the CSC NCR’s findings that the employee failed to file his SALN for 2005.
